## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; mixed sector leadership with Energy, Utilities and Financials showing relative strength while Technology and Consumer Discretionary lag, which together support a neutral posture with weak breadth confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology soft: GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary and Communication under pressure with BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND and TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors represented in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION, SYK (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -7.08% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and Software names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W movers: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY. Note major divergence risk: several large-cap Tech names show 1W/1M splits (INTC, INTC recovery vs MSFT CORRECTION, ADBE CORRECTION) — treat as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-soft: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +10.67%) ABOVE TREND, but GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION — internal rotation within Tech with notable dispersion; overall sector 1W: -0.70%.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious constructive: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND and Financials 1W: +0.43% with mixed internals (V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION). Financials are providing stability but lack broad momentum to confirm risk-on.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Stable defensive tone: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%) ABOVE TREND, while LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND — Healthcare 1W: +0.15% shows modest internal strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy and select Utilities and Industrials leaders (MPC, VLO, DE) while reducing exposure to specific high-multiple Tech names showing CORRECTION (MSFT, ADBE, INTU). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given narrow positive-sector breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PANW (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +13.73%) showing clear momentum; Utilities (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%) also strong. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +2.14%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -5.15%) for potential follow-through weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND for continuation above recent highs; AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND for confirmation of tech stability; DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND as industrial leadership test — failure in these names would deepen dispersion.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
META (+55): META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment from legal settlement commentary is confirming strength. NVDA (+50): NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND — bullish narrative aligns with price appreciation. XOM (+50): XOM (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND — analyst optimism confirms Energy bid.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
F (-60): F (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND — negative recall headlines but price is rising, a divergence to monitor (distribution risk). AMZN (-50): AMZN (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND — news confirms downside pressure. ORCL (-45): ORCL (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +10.67%) ABOVE TREND — regulatory headlines are bearish but price is rising, flag as divergence.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND and Energy names MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: narrow positive-sector breadth (Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive) and several large-cap Tech/Software 1W/1M divergences (MSFT CORRECTION, ADBE CORRECTION) plus mixed sentiment/price divergences (F, ORCL) — watch for trend confirmation.
